candidate.name: 4-phenylbutyrate class and bile-acid chemical chaperones (TX-003 class)

disease_assertion.endpoint: WWOX protein detectable by Western blot (lysate fraction not separated)
disease_assertion.source: claim_registry_current CLAIM 019 (functional source: PAPER 041, a single-laboratory study)
disease_assertion.locator: CLAIM 019, paragraph 'DATO FUNZIONALE, CAUSA NON RISOLTA'; PAPER 041
disease_assertion.measured_result_note: Transcript comparable to reference lines, protein band not detected. One membrane, one exposure, one donor line, no healthy fibroblast control, no densitometry, no n. No proteasome inhibitor, chaperone, synthesis, solubility or half-life measurement exists; the authors leave open impaired translation or premature degradation. The endpoint is 'mRNA normal + protein not detected', not a post-translational mechanism.

context.species: human protein in HEK293 cells and Drosophila glia

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: The class rescued the fully retained variant and NOT the partly trafficked G443D; the rescued variants recover part of wild-type capacity with altered affinity; wild-type capacity is raised too.

drug_assertions.target_id: wild-type client protein of each target tested
drug_assertions.endpoint: wild-type protein abundance under the class
drug_assertions.source: four R1 readings (30266908, 42157447, 42587736, 40485335); NOT WWOX EVIDENCE
drug_assertions.measured_result_note: The class raises wild-type protein in every target of the lot: the effect is not variant-specific.

drug_assertions.target_id: SLC6A1:GAT-1 protein, variant G443D (partly trafficked, inactive)

context.species: human protein in HEK293 cells and Drosophila glia

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: MEASURED NO RESCUE (behaviour unchanged). Encoded NO_CHANGE: a reported null, not an unmeasured cell.

MEASURED NO RESCUE in null alleles, protein not measured, bath concentration bounded by larval toxicity, assay separation of controls unestablished; INCONCLUSIVE for a protein-expressing missense allele. Encoded NO_CHANGE.

context.species: human protein in HEK293T; mouse knock-in lines

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: The HDAC-inhibitor comparator raised the total amount of immature protein with a small, variant-dependent function gain (the authors read non-specific accumulation; partial dissociation of quantity from function, not a clean quantity-up, function-flat case) and worsened an EEG count in one line; the mechanism ascribed to the phenylbutyrate arm (chaperone rather than HDAC inhibition) is inferential, and a direct binding, thermal-stability or folding measurement is NOT ESTABLISHED HERE.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Return of detectable, soluble, functional WWOX protein from a Q230P-class missense lesion; the proximal readout would be total, soluble and pellet WWOX plus a WWOX function assay, none of which exists for this allele.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None for WWOX. Adjacent precedents measure protein and function together in other proteins and the two come apart in six of them (R1 question 2); no function readout for WWOX is defined in the repository.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Every precedent is an overexpression cell line, a worm, a fly, a zebrafish null or a short mouse exposure of a membrane or secretory-pathway protein; none is an enzyme from its own promoter, and none measured brain exposure beside mutant-protein level.

cellular_context.target_expression: UNKNOWN for relevant human neural cells and stages; the only Q230P measurement is one patient fibroblast line.
cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Precedents: HEK293/HEK293T, Neuro2a, worm, fly glia, zebrafish larva, knock-in mouse thalamus and cortex. Q230P-relevant neurons and oligodendrocyte-lineage cells: not studied with this class.
cellular_context.coverage: Target expression and drug selectivity are different questions; neither is answered here. The class is not selective (it raises wild-type protein).
cellular_context.limits: WWOX is cytosolic. The measured behaviour of the class as a chaperone of an ER-retained branch concerns membrane or secretory-pathway clients, and the repository withdrew this class once for a wrong-compartment rationale (DIS-004). Whether that objection survives the HDAC-inhibitor and heat-shock-co-induction readings is open (REVIVAL_TRIGGER live). INFERENZA, blind audit OWED.

p4_card.identity: 4-phenylbutyrate (and the related salt forms) and bile-acid chemical chaperones (e.g. the TUDCA class), taken together because TX-003 lists them together. The two are not interchangeable; the SLC6A1 reading found a similar variant-by-variant pattern only for the bile acid. Formulation relevant to any use: UNKNOWN.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WOREE (Q230P-class missense) as target. Origin contexts: STXBP1, SLC6A1, GABRA1 and GAT-1 variants in cells, worm, fly, zebrafish and mouse (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE). Bridge limit: a chaperone of an ER-retained membrane protein is not shown to act on a cytosolic SDR enzyme; wild type is raised as well.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA as a test in any WWOX system (registry-based, known-roads note section 2.8, 2026-10-20); no dedicated PubMed query for these molecules was run for this card. 4-PBA/TUDCA were carried as TX-003 and withdrawn on rationale (DIS-004), not on a result. NOT MAI_TENTATO-proof: unpublished individual experience is unreachable by any literature query.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: inconclusive (rationale withdrawn, not refuted; no WWOX test).
p4_card.expected_contribution: Function recovery of residual WWOX protein is the only contribution hypothesised; compensation, symptom and protection are not claimed. The branch (retained, cleared, insoluble) must be placed before any contribution can be stated.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: the folding or trafficking fate of a destabilised client; type of action debated between chemical chaperone, HDAC inhibition (transcriptional raise of the cDNA), stress-pathway modulation and heat-shock co-induction; direction: up in protein; context: ER-retained membrane clients. In the one paper that compared mechanism classes the evidence for chaperoning is inferential.

internal: TX-003, DIS-004, D-03 as cited in the known-roads note (arimoclomol-type candidate, withdrawn the same day)

for: Allele-specific rescue of a fully ER-retained variant with protein and function read together (GAT-1 G443V, fly seizure-like episodes down).
Total and surface protein rise in other missense lesions with the class.
against: Wild type is raised in every target: the effect is not mutant-specific.
Not rescued: the partly trafficked G443D; null zebrafish (protein not measured); butyrate raised total immature protein with a small, variant-dependent function gain.
Mouse exposures were short (days); no brain exposure measured beside mutant protein; the human arm of one paper is one uncontrolled child.
No enzyme-class precedent for the class; the enzyme precedents use degradation blockade or an active-site binder.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Cytosolic enzyme versus ER-retained membrane client; overexpression versus own promoter.

p4_card.time_to_access: UNKNOWN. Not documented in the repository.
p4_card.time_to_benefit: UNKNOWN. Not documented; no WWOX datum exists from which to estimate it.
p4_card.pharmacology: Potency, relevant exposure and selectivity in a WWOX system: UNKNOWN. In the sources: class not selective for the mutant; brain exposure not measured in any R1 paper.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: Rescue of the retained branch seen in two papers of one target family (GAT-1 variants); no replication in an enzyme-class or WWOX system.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: R1 readings carry recorded receipts and PASS manifests; the R1 narrowings are OWED a blind locator audit by another actor (an audit of some R1 triples is running in parallel; its outcome is not available to this card).

question_history: TX-003 (proposed), DIS-004 (withdrawn rationale, live revival trigger: HDAC-inhibitor or HSP co-inducer role)
arimoclomol-type co-induction withdrawn the same day (D-03: HSC70 delivers the mutant to the lysosome)
CLAIM 019 / CLAIM 030 / CLAIM 032 (Q230P: rescue conditional on distinguishing synthesis, solubility and turnover and on showing function of the recovered protein)
p4_card.predictions: No engine, no score. The in-silico values recorded in CLAIM 019 are IPOTESI about a folding perturbation of Q230P, not predictions about any drug; they stay IPOTESI.
p4_card.next_measurement: Three-fraction (soluble, pellet, total) plus an inhibitor arm, then a chase from a detectable baseline, on the exact variant, with a WWOX function readout. The result decides whether the class is even addressed to the right branch.
p4_card.status_reason: Mechanism of the class contested; rescue allele-specific; rationale withdrawn once and revival trigger live. Deferred until the lesion's fate is placed.
p4_card.value_added: Separates what the class did in other proteins (retained-branch rescue, non-selectivity, non-rescue) from what is unknown for Q230P, and names the compartment objection.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

not_known: Where the Q230P protein is lost: never made, made and cleared, made and insoluble, made and epitope-invisible, or truncated. No fractionation, inhibitor, synthesis or half-life datum exists for the exact variant.

Whether any recovered Q230P protein would carry WWOX function: there is no per-molecule WWOX function assay in the repository, and protein quantity does not imply function (six measured divergences in R1).

The share of destabilised-missense lesions that are stability lesions for a WWOX SDR-domain variant: the estimates carried in the literature are cited estimates, and the SDR-domain thermal stability is a missing measurement.
No drug has been given to any WWOX model carrying a missense or a splice allele (known-roads note, section 5).
Whether a cytosolic enzyme lesion behaves like the ER-retained branch at all.
Whether the class, if it acts, acts through chaperoning or through raising expression of the allele.
evidence_against: Rationale withdrawn once in this repository.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations or exposures of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.
no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card; the sources are the repository's own receipted notes and records.
